surface_name: Notion API file uploads and Free workspace limits
title: Notion REST API returns 403 on a Free workspace once the block limit is reached
symptoms: HTTP 403 from page or block writes in an internal or selected-workspace OAuth connection
Writes that worked before September 1, 2026 now fail on a Free workspace
cause: Starting September 1, 2026, the REST API enforces the existing Free workspace block limit for internal connections and OAuth connections restricted to selected workspaces. The limit was not previously enforced for these API calls.
fix: Reduce block count, upgrade the workspace plan, or review the grace period and background template behavior in the Workspace block limits docs. Treat this 403 as non-retryable.
apply: Check the workspace block count against the Free plan limit before bulk writes; do not retry the 403
affected: Free workspaces, internal connections and selected-workspace OAuth connections, from 2026-09-01
